name: Admin Accounting — Credit Card Statements
description: Superuser reviews the monthly credit-card statement ledger at /panel/accounting/statements: backend-driven year options (from the catalog's statements_since; months before it show 'No aplica') + card filters over a 12-month grid (Procesado/Borrador/Pendiente chips per card), inline statement detail (totals stat cards, category bars, transactions table flagging unidentified lines, 'Documento del extracto' PDF block with upload/view/replace/delete), finalize with forced-close confirm on total mismatch (POST /api/accounting/statements/:id/finalize/), reopen, delete, header edit modal and manual add-transaction on drafts, per-line delete on drafts, and single-click inline editing of fecha/descripcion/comercio/categoria/cuota/valor directly in the table (dashed underline + hover pencil as the affordance): comercio is a combobox over the learned merchant catalog that offers to remember the alias afterwards (POST /api/accounting/merchant-aliases/learn/) and can carry its default category, cuota is captured as a structured number/total pair, and negative amounts (refunds) edit inline keeping their sign. Editing a processed statement is allowed through a reopen-and-edit confirmation, since the backend keeps refusing writes on non-draft statements. Also: the per-line modal covering fecha, descripcion, comercio, categoria, cuota, valor and notas, and a 'Copiar prompt' button for the MCP chat kick-off. The collapsible 'Comercios aprendidos' table below the detail carries the same single-click inline editing over texto a mapear / comercio / categoria (PATCH /api/accounting/merchant-aliases/:id/update/, which re-normalizes the descriptor and rejects one already owned by another alias) plus per-row delete. Statements are normally created from the claude.ai chat via the accounting MCP connector (create_statement). Each transaction and learned-merchant row leads with a three-dots menu: Detalle e historial, Ver nota when present, Editar for transactions and Eliminar (only while the statement is a draft for transactions); below 1024 px the kebab leads each card.
